name: 406. Gemini embedding batches run through asyncBatchEmbedContent (gemini embedding-batch)
description: Wire-level pins for Gemini embedding batches (TXE-6637; contract clauses C3, C8; Gemini batch B4). A batch of /v1/embeddings lines used to be refused on Gemini as a url a generateContent batch cannot run. Rows 406.1 to 406.4 run against a live gateway; rows 406.5 to 406.8 run against the provider error fixture and its isolated gateway (tests/e2e/api/README.md, --env-var providerErrorFixture=1) and are skipped otherwise, and the two rows that need the real vendor (406.1, 406.4) are skipped on the fixture. Live rows: (406.1) inline /v1/embeddings lines create one models/{model}:asyncBatchEmbedContent job: the echoed request body carries one EmbedContentRequest per input (a line with two inputs is two requests), each with the content, outputDimensionality and taskType the sync route sends, and the line's custom_id, url and input position in its metadata; the batch is cancelled at once. (406.2) a chat line in an embedding batch and (406.3) an embeddings line with no input are refused naming the line; nothing is sent upstream. (406.4) retrieve, cancel and results of a Gemini batch call upstream with the key the caller names in x-bf-api-key and with no other key, and report it in x-bifrost-routing-info-key: a run-scoped provider on the Gemini base has a dead key and a live key, both enabled for batches, and the body says which answered (Gemini's own 400 "API key not valid" or the live key's answer for a batch id that does not exist). Fixture rows: (406.5) the fixture's recorded calls are reset. (406.6) the same create reaches the fixture as exactly one asyncBatchEmbedContent call whose recorded body is what the gateway reports it sent, three requests for two lines. (406.7) the results of the fixture's finished batch, seven vendor responses for four lines, are OpenAI-shape embeddings lines paged in lines: limit=2 returns the one-input line and the three-input line put back together (data[0..2], usage 15) with a next_cursor, the next page the two failed lines with the vendor's error codes, and retrieve reports completed. (406.8) a run-scoped provider pointed at the fixture has a dead and a live key: retrieve and results with each named key reach the fixture bearing that key and no other, read back from the fixture's record of the x-goog-api-key of every batch read. The /genai route does not carry :asyncBatchEmbedContent and is not covered. Run with FEATURE="embedding-batch".
